description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the Permissions interface, providing methods to create and manipulate permission sets in an immutable manner, including conversion to JSON format.

classes.name: ImmutablePermissions
classes.description: An immutable set implementation of the Permissions interface, providing methods for creating permission collections, checking permissions, and converting to JSON.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Returns a Permissions object representing an empty set of permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Permissions object initialized with the given permission(s).

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the permission set contains specific permission(s).

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of permissions in the set.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the permission set to a JSON array.
